info.title: Gasket version 1 maintenance API
info.description: Versioned estate, procedure, assignment, execution and independent review examples. API.md documents additional native actions and field semantics. This file does not claim complete target-entity schema coverage. POST requests require the installation Origin header. The nine approved service scopes remain restricted to estate operations; new procedure and execution operations require ordinary member sessions.
